name: Hearth
for: a bakery, café, deli or any shop people visit on their way somewhere
description: Warm and editorial: today's bake as a priced board in the first screen, an order-for-pickup form that works without JavaScript, hours and the way in. Serif display over a cream ground; dark mode is a lamp-lit counter.

images.prompt: A photograph of the morning's bread on a floured wooden counter, a split sourdough boule in front, raking window light from the left, warm and quiet, no people, shallow depth of field

type.display: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
